title: Reinforcing Loops
hook: Happy customers bring customers who bring more. No new idea beats that.
statement: What grows, grows faster. Keep feeding it.
explainer: Referrals, reviews, repeat buyers compound. Feed the winner before chasing shiny.
sop: Set its current Base and Rate.
Remove one thing killing its momentum.
equation_example: Base 10 referrals, Rate 20% a month, Time 6. 10 × 1.2^6 = about 30. Tripled.
question: Name your strongest loop. Feed it this week.
closing_statement: Feed the loop before starting a new one.
